title: Van for Existence: Sok Árus Van

sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Unlike the identity sentences above, van IS used here — because this sentence reports that something exists, not what something is.

items.spanish: Itt a piac. Sok árus van.
items.english: Here's the market. There are many vendors.

sections.content: Sok árus van uses van correctly for existence. Compare this to Ez a zöldség, where van would be wrong. The difference is identity (no van) versus existence/location (van).
